text: A demo agent can call tools, yet nothing checks that writes happened, that notes stayed data, or that the budget held. Offline workshop: fake model, fictional depot, no network.
The scripted assistant looks up a bin and reads a note: three model calls, two reads. Simulated cost zero point zero zero zero one two dollars, network none.
A tiny teaching server speaks JSON-RPC over standard input and output, with two read tools. Ask it to adjust stock: refused, the write tool is not exported. A small subset, not the official MCP SDK.

The gate scores invariants, not a fixed tool order. Six golden cases, zero failed; the two lookups use different tool orders. The checker agrees with the author on five of six; one disagreement, shown.
The lab agent that obeys an injected note changes stock. The gate goes red, exit one, as expected.
Learners start from failing exercises: module one, six failures. Solutions pass, modules one to eight.
Caveats. Not delivered; two sessions of three hours is E-S-T. The model is a script: passing the gate means the synthetic cases passed, not production readiness. MCP here is a small subset.

Deployment strategist angle: discovery first, not a model name. Shadow against a cassette and the gate. Only then a live provider, behind the same gate. Not covered: real identity, review queue, hosted runner. Labs cost zero vendor spend. Business figures are E-S-T.
